common_name: See No Evil Hosta (Chartreuse-Green Sport of Funky Monkey)

planting.note: Plant divisions in early fall or spring in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial to full shade, giving the clump room to arch outward as it matures.

directions: This sport of the chartreuse Hosta 'Funky Monkey' emerges with glossy, pointed leaves edged in a wavy yellow margin that fades toward cream as the season progresses, while the leaf centers vary shoot to shoot between cream-veined green, mostly cream, and occasionally all green. Red petioles carry the arching foliage into a broad mound, and lavender flowers appear on red scapes in late summer. Because the variegation pattern shifts from stem to stem and year to year, clumps of this hosta tend to look slightly different each season, which makes it a good conversation piece near a shaded path or patio.
